changelog: Phase L103.2 — active-location session plumbing. New /api/set-active-location.php (CSRF-guarded, employee+ role) writes $_SESSION['active_location_id']. Database::activeLocationId() lazy-resolves with fallback to first active location. Database::syncLocationToControlPlane() mirrors tenant-DB locations into control-plane tenant_locations on every saveLocation/deleteLocation (best-effort, fail-open). New /css/location-switcher.css + /js/location-switcher.js render an inline switcher in account-header.php (visible only when staff role + >1 active location). ZERO behaviour change for tenants with a single location or for customer role — switcher is hidden.
